subject.title: [Bug]: codex agent fails ("exited with code 1") — macOS XProtect deletes bundled @openai/codex@0.128.0 as malware; codex-acp@0.0.44 pins the flagged version

question: Should acpx keep deterministic bundled Codex selection with an explicit `CODEX_PATH` recovery path, or make a Codex-specific exception that automatically selects a system binary after bundled startup failure?
rationale: The adapter upgrade is a bounded compatibility task, but automatic fallback changes who owns runtime version selection and conflicts with prior maintainer-visible direction against implicit PATH preference.

options.title: Upgrade and document
options.body: Compatibility-test a newer adapter, keep bundled execution as the default, and document `CODEX_PATH` for explicit recovery.

options.title: Codex-only fallback
options.body: Upgrade the adapter and add a narrowly scoped fallback to a PATH-resolved Codex only after bundled startup failure.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Keep adapter 0.0.44 and rely on the shipped stderr summary plus manual recovery documentation.

recommendation.title: Upgrade and document
recommendation.body: Compatibility-test a newer adapter, keep bundled execution as the default, and document `CODEX_PATH` for explicit recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete supplied the prior product-direction decision on implicit PATH selection and owns recent adapter-range and release history.
